segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Fenna,role:Wizard,race:orc,gender:female,align:chaotic
OPTIONS=playmode:debug,!tutorial,!legacy,!verbose,menucolors,autopickup,pickup_types:all
MSGTYPE=norep "(((There+)*$+))(is(There)+|(You).)[a-cx-z]+(an(\2*|( ){0,3})+)?"
AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION="<(\w+ +)see"
MENUCOLOR="There+[[.a.]]"=cyan&underline
AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION="[^a-z]{2,}(\(*\1*|(([a-z])[[:digit:]]?|\.)*){2}"
MSGTYPE=hide "door+^+((an([a-z]{0,5}uncursed|wand*)*){1,}apple)*"
MSGTYPE=show "^((.{1,4}|corpsescroll?)){3}(It{1}){1}e*\({2}"
MSGTYPE=hide "(.scroll+)$"
